result.notes:
FIX ROUND — one edit only, exactly as instructed; no rewrite, no new files.

What changed: the XML doc on IEnvironment.GetBaseDirectory() in src/AgentGuard.Abstractions/Contracts/IEnvironment.cs. Removed the trailing-separator over-spec — the old <summary> said "The value is returned faithfully, including its trailing directory separator" and the <returns> said "terminated with a directory separator." New doc describes it plainly: "the base directory the application was loaded from, as the runtime reports it ... wraps System.AppContext.BaseDirectory ... returned faithfully, mirroring the underlying primitive," and <returns> is "The absolute base directory the application was loaded from." No trailing-separator / "terminated with a directory separator" language remains.

The method SIGNATURE is unchanged (string GetBaseDirectory()) — this is a documentation-only change, so nothing downstream ripples and no test needs to change to compile.

Verified untouched per the fix instruction (read live, not from memory):
- EnvironmentAdapter.GetBaseDirectory() => throw new NotSupportedException();  (the RED throwing stub — IMPLEMENT reads AppContext.BaseDirectory verbatim). Left as-is; NotSupportedException, not NotImplementedException, is the existing MA0025-sanctioned unimplemented-stub throw this skeleton uses across the board.
- FakeEnvironment.GetBaseDirectory() => _baseDirectory;  (plain pass-through). Left as-is.
- FakeEnvironment.Create(..., string? baseDirectory = null, ...) -> baseDirectory ?? home. Left as-is.

Nothing else touched. Born compliant under the live analyzers (all 14 projects incl. AgentGuard.Analyzers built): dotnet build -c Release = 0 warnings / 0 errors, exit 0.
